name: Burnt Hills Farmers' Market

description: Burnt Hills Farmers' Market is a farmers market in 120 Lake Hill Road Burnt Hills, NY, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
